detailZones.title: Left fruit crates
detailZones.description: Inspect the left fruit crates, banana bunches, grapes, pears and apple displays.

detailZones.title: Central fruit display
detailZones.description: Follow the orange, grapefruit, lemon, lime and mixed-apple trays around the center display.

detailZones.title: Scale and bag station
detailZones.description: Explore the produce scale, stainless bowl, paper-bag roll, counter and handbasket.

detailZones.title: Leafy greens and herbs
detailZones.description: Inspect the mist rail, leafy greens, lettuce, herbs and wooden greens trays.

detailZones.title: Vegetable trays
detailZones.description: Follow the tomato, carrot, broccoli, cauliflower, mushroom, pepper, cabbage and root-vegetable trays.

detailZones.title: Lower produce storage
detailZones.description: Explore the lower onion and potato baskets, asparagus tray, display shelving, casters and floor mat.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized produce-department photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 150 independently pointable fruit, vegetable, display, weighing, bagging and store-fixture objects across 6 bounded zones. Printed prices, labels, brands, freshness claims, customer identity, purchase state and hidden functions were excluded.
